overview: Wielu is a star system in the Inner Rim Territories, within the Zuma Sector, at galactic grid N-13, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Wielu appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Inner Rim Territories.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Wielu's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Wielu is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Inner Rim Territories chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Inner Rim Territories sector records
